top_choice_rationale: The diffuse flux of TeV-PeV astrophysical neutrinos is a genuine discovery of something no theory predicted, extracted from atmospheric backgrounds many orders of magnitude larger and seen in several channels with different systematics. Cited on the diffuse flux alone, it does not depend on source associations. The Halzen-Karle allocation is the open weakness; the optical lattice clock (P002) is the clean-credit fallback, and the topological insulator trio (P001) is conceptually strong but its credit is contested.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no known tie to Halzen, Karle or IceCube, though I work in astroparticle detectors (PAMELA, Fermi-LAT, XL-Calibur) and may favour detector-driven results
